description: Arbitrage across FanDuel, DraftKings and Novig: two sides of one market at different venues whose prices guarantee a profit, with stakes that pay the same either way. type=middles finds middles (two lines with a window where both legs win). Use it for "any arbs on tonight's NBA games?". Developer plan and up; Free gets a short labelled sample and the upgrade link. A default call costs 5 credits (table: https://fanduelapi.com/credits).
